### 🟡 Changes recommended `watch_unreadable` is currently accounted as a `fallbacks` increment even though the watcher path keeps the already-running shader (no embedded fallback), making `ShaderStats.fallbacks` semantics inconsistent and affecting multiple unit tests. *Once you've addressed the issues Copilot identified, you can request another Copilot review.*
Pull request overview This PR makes the shader hot-reload watcher’s bookkeeping logic reachable from `zig build test` by extracting the decision/counter-updating rules into `src/gpu/metal/reload.zig` (a Metal-free module) and ensuring its tests are collected and its declaration-sweep convention is enforced. **Changes:** - Adds `src/gpu/metal/reload.zig` (decision tables + `Counters` + `Watch` state machine) and exercises it under unit tests. - Extends `src/main.zig`’s test-root imports and the “declaration sweep” module list to include `gpu/metal/reload.zig`. - Updates explanatory comments/docs (iface counter invariants, build plan status for #93, AGENTS.md project narrative).
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | src/gpu/metal/reload.zig | New Metal-free reload bookkeeping (outcome→counter deltas, `Counters`, watcher state machine) with unit tests. | | src/main.zig | Imports `reload.zig` from the test root; adds it to the module sweep list. | | src/gpu/iface.zig | Updates the `ShaderStats`/counter invariant commentary now that `Counters.note` is compiled in tests. | | docs/plans/todo/2026-07-25-repo-foundation-and-phased-build-plan.md | Marks #93 as Done and updates narrative and test counts. | | AGENTS.md | Updates project state notes to include #93 landing and the new module. |
Review details ### Suppressed comments (2) **src/gpu/metal/reload.zig:391** * This expectation currently asserts `watch_unreadable` increments `fallbacks`, but the watcher path does not use the embedded copy. If `watch_unreadable` is treated as a rejection (so `fallbacks` remains “embedded fallback”), update this row accordingly. ``` try testing.expectEqual(Deltas{ .fallbacks = 1 }, deltas(.watch_unreadable)); ``` **src/gpu/metal/reload.zig:530** * This test relies on `watch_unreadable` contributing to `fallbacks`. If watcher unreadables are counted as `rejected` instead (and `fallbacks` reserved for embedded-copy fallback), the expected published stats need to be updated to keep this “field wiring” test meaningful (distinct values, no transposition false-pass). ``` .rejected = 2, .fallbacks = 3, ``` - **Files reviewed:** 9/9 changed files - **Comments generated:** 1 - **Review effort level:** Lite
